The '''BL-28 blaster''' was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The BL-28 blaster was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Star Cluster Nightlife Pack.
